notes.title: Update 4.3
notes.content:
Wanted to fix this.

""When you work at some place and you hit the "E" button IMMEDIATELY (very quick) after the "F" for "work" it automatically ends the shift at 1""

You can now no longer hit 1 ( bad shift ) right after starting to work at any job. It will wait till a reset from 9 before it will let you hit 1.
